title: Does a mayor improve a city beyond chance? Missing data at a change of mayor makes the test say yes: Replication package
description: Replication package of the methods paper on the size of the RIFLE test (Berry and Fowler) with gaps in the middle of the series. Code under Apache-2.0; paper text and figures under CC BY 4.0. The paper is in Portuguese (original), English, Spanish and Italian.
